hero.title: Inside a Breathe session, step by step
hero.subtitle: From opening the app to the moment your shoulders drop, here's exactly what happens.
intro.title: Five steps, no setup required
intro.body: Breathe is designed so the first session takes under a minute, with nothing to configure unless you want to.
item-1.title: Open the app
item-1.body: No account, no sign-in. Breathe opens straight to the session screen.
item-2.title: Choose a background
item-2.body: Pick from video and photo atmospheres like Beach, River, or Space, downloaded once for offline sessions.
item-3.title: Set your rhythm
item-3.body: Use a preset like Relax (4/6 second rhythm) or build a custom inhale/exhale timing.
item-4.title: Follow the pulse
item-4.body: A gentle breathing circle expands and contracts to guide your pace.
item-5.title: Review your session
item-5.body: See a short summary and your selections are saved for next time.
facts.title: Built to stay out of your way
facts.body: No ads, no tracking, and everything works without a connection.
cta.title: Take a breath. The good kind.
cta.body: A few minutes is all it takes. Download Breathe and start your first session today.
